title: Driftward Plateau
description: A grass-capped, fractured limestone plateau with exposed bedding and detached skyline fragments.

review.notes: Round 3 (final). Fixed: the pillow/cushion rows are gone; the top now has rolling terrain, tree clusters, shrubs, rocks and a path; the scale figure is readable in the upper close-up. Not fixed: (1) cliffs are now stacks of rectilinear boxes (cardboard/crate look) instead of fractured strata; there are no thin and thick layers, no vertical joints and no overhangs. (2) The underside is still a few blunt rectangular columns with no clear asymmetric taper or keel (round-2 point 2). (3) Detached fragments are cube and rectangular pillar shapes, not broken chunks matching the strata (round-2 point 3). (4) closeup.jpg: the cliff face is large flat low-poly planes in one flat grey, with no rock texture, cracks or colour variation between strata. (5) hero.jpg frames the island small in the centre, so the silhouette is hard to judge.
